title: Darren G NDE 958
content: At the moment that my heart stopped I rose above my body and kept going. I saw clouds and then my deceased father of maybe two years. He told me to go back. It wasn't my turn. I had things to do. So, I did and nothing has been the same. I don't know if I have completed what he wanted but I am lost.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Surgery-related Had to have speen removed unexplained virus. No life expectancy.Heart stopped. Saw deceased father. he said to go back.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes It seemed like fog or clouds.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes The light is what I was approaching until my father showed up and wanted me to go back because I wasn't finished yet.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Relief, anxious,happiness, confusion, bewilderness, alone and confidant.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe Things were not the same as I earlier believed.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future I believe that he wanted me to give him a granddaughter very much and if I accomplished that he wanted me to prove that males in his family can live a long and fulfilled life.
